note: Which grammar scan belongs to which unit. Every entry is marked for review because the document contradicts itself: its own headings group the eight images 1/3/2/2 under 'Unit 1'..'Unit 4', but each image is a floating anchor whose position in the file is not its position on the page, and the images' own worked examples match a 2-per-unit grouping. The mapping below follows the content. A teacher confirms it against the printed pages before anything is published. Titles are transcribed from each sheet; nothing here is authored.

scans.title: المبني للمجهول في المضارع البسيط
scans.evidence: Passive voice in the present simple. Matches the unit's grammar exercise 'Insects are eaten by other animals'.

scans.title: Where Clauses
scans.evidence: Worked examples are 'The jungle is where tigers hunt' and 'The trees are where monkeys play', which are the unit's own exercise sentences.

scans.title: Conditional Sentences
scans.evidence: Zero and first conditional. Matches 'If you eat your breakfast, you will have more energy'.

scans.title: Countable & Uncountable Nouns
scans.evidence: a few / a little. Matches 'Why don't we add a little olives' and 'I need a little salt on my salad'.

scans.title: Present Perfect
scans.evidence: since / for and How long. Matches 'I have lived here since 2028'.

scans.title: Present Perfect Keywords
scans.evidence: ever, never, just, already, yet. Matches 'Have you ever read sports magazine'.

scans.title: Simple Past & Past Progressive
scans.evidence: Matches 'They designed a new house last week' and 'He was studying when she arrived'.

scans.title: Restrictive Relative Clauses
scans.evidence: who / which / that. Matches 'The man which saved the children was young'.
